name: Kazerne Osdorp
description: Opened in 2005, Osdorp’s station was designed by dietzsch + van der sanden around the rapid movement of crews and vehicles. Its transparent vehicle hall has a rolling sedum roof; a glazed corridor joins it to a quieter brick block containing the crew’s living spaces. The station is also known as the Fanny Blankers-Koen kazerne.
facts: The rolling hall roof expresses the onward movement of an emergency turnout.
A glazed corridor separates the vehicle hall from the brick accommodation wing.
The sedum roof responds to the landscaped side of the site.
destinationNote: Main external pedestrian entrance under source-visible balcony, mapped on exact native southern facade, route pin1.85m outward into open forecourt. Station interiors not publicly accessible; preserve destination on route failure.
